site.name: Alamakee
overview: Alamakee was one of the original mining discoveries at Gold Hill and is documented in federal mining history and historic Boulder-area archival records.

timeline.text: Federal mining history identifies Alamakee among the original discoveries at Gold Hill.
A surviving Boulder Historical Society/Carnegie Library photograph identifies the Alamakee Mine in the Gold Hill landscape.

moreHistory: USGS mining history documents the Alamakee name at Gold Hill, while mapped locality evidence provides a stable mine-level identification anchor near 40.06611, -105.40472.
The known 1895 archival photograph is retained as research evidence, but its item-level reuse basis is not sufficiently clear for Remnant packaging. It is therefore not shipped in the app.
